CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `devSettings` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `key` varchar(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  `value` text NOT NULL,
  `description` text,
  `updatedBy` int,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `devSettings_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `devSettings_updatedBy_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`updatedBy`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `errorLogs` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `errorType` enum('falsification','source_mismatch','system_error','llm_error') NOT NULL,
  `message` text NOT NULL,
  `stackTrace` text,
  `context` text,
  `userId` int,
  `sessionId` int,
  `resolved` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  CONSTRAINT `errorLogs_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `errorLogs_userId_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`userId`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `errorLogs_sessionId_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`sessionId`) REFERENCES `chatSessions`(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `qualityMetrics` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `sessionId` int,
  `messageId` int,
  `falsificationDetected` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  `sourceMismatch` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  `confidenceScore` decimal(5,2),
  `sourceUrl` text,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  CONSTRAINT `qualityMetrics_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `qualityMetrics_sessionId_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`sessionId`) REFERENCES `chatSessions`(`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `qualityMetrics_messageId_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`messageId`) REFERENCES `chatMessages`(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `sourceWhitelist` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `domain` varchar(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  `description` text,
  `active` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  `addedBy` int,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `sourceWhitelist_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `sourceWhitelist_addedBy_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`addedBy`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`)
);
